page.overview:
Who is Ganondorf?

Demon King, Evil King, Ganondorf the Evil King, Evil Incarnation of Darkness, Gerudo King of Thieves, Great Evil King Ganondorf, Great Ganondorf, Great King of Evil, King of Evil, King of the Gerudo Thieves, King of Thieves, Wicked Man of the Desert,

Notably, as Ganon is revealed to be the endless reincarnation of Demise's hatred from , and that villain himself is a humanoid, Ganondorf much more closely resembles him.

Despite the series' central antagonist as a whole debuted in the titular 1986 Nintendo Entertainment System title as a simple monster (alongside Link and Princess Zelda) and Ganondorf making his first on-screen appearance in the 1998 Nintendo 64 installment , released on the Super Nintendo Entertainment System seven years prior is the first mainline game in the franchise revealing that Ganon actually has a human form and therefore wasn't always the giant pig-like demon, with his full name being Ganondorf Dragmire. Ganondorf is also the leader of a group of thieves called Gerudos.

In A Link to the Past, with the help of his followers, as Ganon, he became the first to enter the Sacred Realm in ages. He claimed the Triforce, turning the Sacred Realm into the Dark World and himself into a vastly powerful being. However, he was trapped within the now-corrupted Sacred Realm by the combined efforts of the Knights of Hyrule and the Sages. During the final battle, Ganon reveals that the dark wizard Agahnim is another alter ego of himself, though this particular villain never appears again in later installments, as Link destroyed him completely in the second battle inside Ganon's Tower and it is likely Ganondorf replaced the Wizzrobe-like magician since. Unlike most other titles in the main series, one of the seven Maidens in-game suggests that Ganondorf, rather than Ganon, is his original form.

Also known as: Ganondorf Dragmire, Gerudo King.
